provenance.method: Bounded review of current Android Accessibility Help; device and version variation preserved.

name: Android accessibility features
description: Google's Android Accessibility Help overview covering built-in and downloadable features for vision, hearing, mobility, voice and cognitive accessibility, including Reading mode and Voice Access.
intended_use: Inspecting Android accessibility settings and tools for reading, input, reduced distraction or alternative control.
audience_or_context: Android users; feature availability and navigation differ by Android version, market and device manufacturer.
limitations: First-party feature documentation is not proof of personal suitability or accessibility quality on every device.
Some features require separate downloads or supported Android versions.
cost_or_access_notes: Many features are built in or free to download; hardware and data costs remain separate.
conflicts_of_interest: Google develops Android and related accessibility apps; ND Oracle records first-party feature documentation without endorsement.
